name: NeetoDesk
description:
NeetoDesk is helpdesk software. Customers raise requests as tickets, agents reply through comments, and reports summarise response times and customer satisfaction. This connector lets Claude work with your NeetoDesk workspace in plain language.

Ask Claude to triage the queue, read the full comment history on a ticket, draft or post a reply to the customer, or leave an internal note for the team. It can create tickets and customers, change status, priority, category, tags and assignment, invite and manage team members, and pull ticket, agent, group and satisfaction reports over any date range.

Because the details are usually already in the conversation, a forwarded complaint or a pasted thread turns into a ticket, or into a drafted reply, without you retyping anything.

Connect over OAuth and the connector acts as you: an agent restricted to their own tickets or to their groups sees ticket lists, searches and reports narrowed to that same scope, and managing team members needs the member-management permission. Replies written through the connector are stored on the ticket and are never emailed to the customer.

_published_faq.name: How do I add NeetoDesk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add NeetoDesk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://connect.neetodesk.com/mcp/messages. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the NeetoDesk MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: NeetoDesk lists 23 MCP tools, including CreateCustomer, CreateTeamMember, CreateTicket, CreateTicketComment, CreateTicketDraft, DeleteTeamMember, GetAgentReports, GetGroupReports, GetSurveyReports, GetTeamMember, GetTicket, and GetTicketComment.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to NeetoDesk?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to NeetoDesk in customer-support on the Manufact MCP catalog include Assembled, Brainfish, ClearFeed, Conduit, and DevRev.
NeetoDesk requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
NeetoDesk is developed by Neeto. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
